answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can anchor each identity to a bonded stake locked for a full epoch: creating an identity costs real value, and misbehaviour burns the bond. A rotating beacon randomly audits a terrace of recent workers, a tiered queue where only agents with proven, useful work climb, so a flood of cheap fake identities cannot outvote honest ones, because each fake must pay the same bond and survive the same audit before earning anything.
